title: Pay for the Fault, Not the Flow: Label-Free In-Flow Multi-Agent Workflow Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.01017v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly construct multi-agent workflows that decompose a complex task and assign specialist agents from a pool. However, building such a workflow well remains challenging: how finely to divide the task, which agent to trust with each subtask, and when to create a new specialist are all critical decisions a workflow constructor needs to settle up front. Thus, whether each subtask succeeds remains unknown until the workflow runs. Yet, improving a workflow is costly. Locating a fault usually requires a reference answer, a graded outcome, or a trained assessor, and the fix is applied to the whole workflow through re-execution, re-search, or retraining. We propose InFlowOp, which prices every decision in one label-free cost that weighs how well an agent's competence meets what a subtask demands against how much that agent takes to run. translated_title: 只为错误买单，不为流程买单：免标签的流程内多智能体工作流优化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于构建多智能体工作流，即将复杂任务进行分解，并从智能体池中指派专门的智能体。然而，构建一个高质量的工作流仍然充满挑战：任务要划分得多细、每个子任务应该信任哪个智能体、以及何时需要创建新的专家智能体，这些都是工作流构建者需要预先确定的关键决策。因此，每个子任务是否成功在工作流运行之前始终是未知的。然而，改进工作流的代价高昂：定位错误通常需要参考答案、分级评分的结果或经过训练的评估器，而修复则是通过对整个工作流进行重新执行、重新搜索或重新训练来实施的。我们提出 InFlowOp，它用一个免标签的代价为每个决策定价，该代价权衡智能体能力与子任务需求的匹配程度，以及运行该智能体所需的成本。在执行之前，InFlowOp 通过双向方式确定任务划分的粒度……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 InFlowOp，一种免标签的流程内多智能体工作流优化方法，用一个统一代价为任务划分、智能体指派等每个决策定价，无需参考答案或训练评估器即可定位并修复工作流中的错误。
en_tdlr: InFlowOp is a label-free in-flow multi-agent workflow optimization method that prices every decision—task granularity, agent assignment, and specialist creation—within a single cost, enabling fault localization and repair without reference answers or trained assessors.
